title: NO REPEATING CALLED LINE
why: His order of 2026-10-09: the raid text reads like a shooter HUD and never repeats what is already on screen. Holding E in a ring already called and still inbound said Called, Inbound and Stay alive again every two and a half seconds. The band above the belt already counts the extraction in, and the EXTRACTION CALLED alert already answers the press, so the repeating line is gone.
now: Holding E in a ring already called no longer repeats a Called line every few seconds.
